hints.title: Prime Boundary Conditions
hints.text: Every beautiful partition segment must start with a prime digit (2, 3, 5, 7) and end with a non-prime digit.

hints.title: Valid Cut Indices
hints.text: A valid cut after index j exists only if s[j] is non-prime and s[j + 1] is prime. Furthermore, s[0] must be prime and s[n-1] must be non-prime.

hints.title: Prefix Sum DP Acceleration
hints.text: Let dp[p][i] represent partitions into p parts up to length i. Maintain a running sum of dp[p - 1][j] for valid split points j <= i - minLength.

hints.title: Running Prefix Dynamic Programming Implementation

complexity.notes: Maintaining running prefix sum reduces transition from quadratic to O(1) per step.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Inner loop over all valid preceding cuts causes cubic O(k * n^2) runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memory using rolling DP arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Optimizes DP state transitions from O(k * n^2) to O(k * n) using sliding prefix sums.
